acme/widgets#142.markdown:
The index was written once per row on startup, so a cold start with ten thousand rows took 1.8 s on the test box. This batches the writes per palette and defers the fsync to the end.

---

**tomas** commented · 9/16/2026

Could this go behind a flag for the first release?

---

**tomas** approved · 9/16/2026

Measured 0.3 s here. Ship it.
